nodes.name: GitStatusBadge.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a compact git-status indicator badge (colored dot for directories, status letter for files) shared across tree row UIs.

nodes.name: TreeRowBase.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared base tree-row component handling indentation, chevron/file-type icons, selection styling, indent guides, and drag/drop handlers; reused by source control, search results, and design tree views.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses React.memo + forwardRef together to allow parent DOM manipulation while avoiding unnecessary re-renders.

nodes.name: VirtualizedListBase.tsx
nodes.summary: Generic virtualized list component wrapping react-virtuoso with scroll-position preservation, scroll restoration on structure changes, and an imperative scroll-to-index handle for tree/list views.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses stable refs and useMemo with empty deps to keep the Virtuoso components instance stable across renders and avoid scroll resets.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Shared layout constants (row height, indentation, padding, icon sizes) and CSS class tokens used by tree row components for consistent styling.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript interfaces (TreeRowNode, GitStatusInfo, TreeRowBaseProps, GitStatusBadgeProps) defining the data contracts for tree row components used across source control, search, and design tree views.

nodes.name: VirtualizedListBaseInner
nodes.summary: Generic inner implementation of the virtualized list: manages scroll-position refs, scroll restoration effects, imperative handle exposure, and item render/key callbacks; wrapped via forwardRef to produce the exported VirtualizedListBase component.
